title: A quantum k-nearest neighbors implementation using magnitude-aware comparisons
abstract: arXiv:2610.33739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Much attention has recently been devoted to the k-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm as a case study for quantum computing algorithms. Several algorithms have devised methods to compute a similarity metric to solve Quantum KNN (QKNN). This paper presents a practical quantum encoding technique that enables Euclidean distance calculation between vectors with different L2 norms by appending a single component to each vector, then uses it in the QKNN problem. It is arguably simpler to understand and implement than comparable methods and uses fewer qubits. Further, an implementation of this algorithm is provided and is used to benchmark it against a recent Euclidean-distance QKNN method on standard labeled datasets. In addition to demonstrating proper formulation, the results show marked improvement over similar implementations during simulation with realistic noise due to the use of fewer qubits and thus more coherent circuits.

translated_title: 一种使用幅度感知比较的量子k近邻实现
translated_abstract: 近来，k近邻（KNN）算法作为量子计算算法的案例研究受到了广泛关注。已有若干算法设计出计算相似度度量的方法来解决量子KNN（QKNN）问题。本文提出了一种实用的量子编码技术，通过在每个向量后附加一个分量，使得具有不同L2范数的向量之间能够进行欧氏距离计算，并将其应用于QKNN问题。与类似方法相比，该技术可以说更易于理解和实现，并且使用更少的量子比特。此外，本文提供了该算法的实现，并在标准标记数据集上与近期一种基于欧氏距离的QKNN方法进行了基准测试比较。除了证明其公式化的正确性之外，由于使用更少的量子比特从而获得了相干性更高的电路，结果表明在含现实噪声的模拟中，该算法相比类似实现有显著的性能改进。
tldr: 本文提出一种实用的量子编码技术，通过在每个向量后附加单个分量来处理不同L2范数向量间的欧氏距离计算，使量子k近邻算法更简单且使用更少量子比特，并在含现实噪声的模拟中展现出显著的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a practical quantum encoding technique that enables Euclidean distance calculation between vectors with different L2 norms by appending a single component to each vector, making the quantum k-nearest neighbors algorithm simpler and using fewer qubits, with markedly improved performance under realistic noise simulation.
